home.description: Systems and Computer Engineer from EIA University, based in Medellín, Colombia. I design multi-tenant SaaS backends, enterprise apps on Power Platform and AI agents that do real work — and I love taking apart how things work.

about.title: Systems and Computer Engineer (EIA University)
about.aboutText: I'm a Systems and Computer Engineering graduate from EIA University. Today I'm the technical lead at PROCOL: I own the technical side and how we build software, hand in hand with our software team lead. There I build a Go + PostgreSQL multi-tenant SaaS on Azure and enterprise apps with Power Apps Code Apps, and I build AI agents for ABACO that write food-security policy bulletins and answer questions over child-nutrition data. Outside work I reverse-engineer file formats and protocols, write native macOS apps and automate my home.

experiences.summary: I lead the technical side — architecture, engineering practices and how we build software — working hand in hand with the software team lead.
highlights: Designed and built the Go + PostgreSQL backend of a construction-contract accounting SaaS: multi-tenant identity with Ory Hydra federated to each customer's Entra ID and Bicep infrastructure on Azure; cut critical queries from 9.4 s to 71 ms.
Adopted Power Apps Code Apps while still in preview and bootstrapped the team's React / TypeScript app on Dataverse with Clean/Hexagonal Architecture.
Dataverse Custom APIs, security roles, fine-grained data access and audited production data migrations.
Integrated AI agents with Power Platform and Teams that review code and build features in Azure DevOps over MCP.
Set up the team's AI-assisted workflow, published a React design system as a private npm package and reverse-engineered Revit's .rvt format into a WebAssembly + Three.js viewer.

experiences.summary: AI agents for Colombia's food bank association.
highlights: Built the multi-agent platform (Pydantic AI on Azure OpenAI) that writes food-security policy bulletins: analysis in a sandbox, Plotly figures and publication-ready PDF and DOCX with human-in-the-loop review.
Built the Observatory agent on AWS Lambda that answers questions over child-nutrition indicators with charts, choropleth maps and time series.
Collaborated on the public chatbot's RAG service and the public-health data pipelines; author of pdfgen-juanipis, the HTML-to-PDF library behind the bulletins.
Replaced a manual Excel process with a Survey123 form (georeferenced photos and voice notes) and a Power Automate flow that stored the data in SharePoint.
Built a Python (Flet) desktop app that generates reports and transcribes audio with faster-whisper.

experiences.summary: Backend and frontend for a fintech platform.
highlights: Go and Python (gRPC) microservices, AI services and Dockerfiles.
Angular-Ionic components, GitLab CI/CD pipelines and bug fixing in Java services.
